def solve(case):
    if not isinstance(case, dict):
        raise ValueError("case must be dict")
    threshold = case.get('threshold')
    if threshold is None:
        raise ValueError("missing threshold")
    calls = case.get('calls')
    if not isinstance(calls, list):
        raise ValueError("calls must be list")
    diagnostics = []
    accepted_call_ids = []
    for call in calls:
        if not isinstance(call, dict):
            raise ValueError("call must be dict")
        call_id = call.get('call_id')
        if call_id is None:
            raise ValueError("missing call_id")
        loss_without = call.get('loss_without_call')
        loss_with = call.get('loss_with_call')
        prediction_tokens = call.get('prediction_tokens')
        parseable = call.get('parseable')
        if None in (loss_without, loss_with, prediction_tokens, parseable):
            raise ValueError("missing required fields in call")
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        normalized_gain = gain / prediction_tokens
        accepted = bool(parseable) and normalized_gain >= threshold
        diagnostics.append({
            "call_id": call_id,
            "accepted": accepted,
            "normalized_gain": normalized_gain
        })
        if accepted:
            accepted_call_ids.append(call_id)
    return {
        "accepted_call_ids": accepted_call_ids,
        "diagnostics": diagnostics
    }
